scope: Local profiles (browser demo, two-party mode, operator harness) on isolated Zebra NU7 regtest and Anvil. Internal work, not an external audit. The public-testnet path was ported the same night (see public_profile); it has synthetic-input checks only.

finding.summary: The refund's 20,000-zatoshi transparent coin was created and mined before every swap, so even a settled swap left a transparent output on chain, a repeatable pattern next to each funding transaction.

fix.construction: At setup Alice's source wallet builds and signs a private auxiliary transaction A: it spends her own F change (one Ironwood spend), creates the 20,000-zatoshi P2PKH coin to a fresh key and returns the rest to her shielded address (fee 15,000). R spends A's output; v6 txids exclude anchors and proofs, so R can commit to A's txid while A stays deferred. Only Alice's participant receives A, over the pinned TLS channel, after the shared bundle. A is sent only on the refund path, then R.
alice_participant_checks: A deferred (no anchor or proof) and identical to its checked copy minus proof data
A proof and every signature valid on a temporary tree
V6/NU7, expiry 0, lock time 0, no transparent input, exactly one output equal to the refund input in the accepted bundle (txid, index, value, script)
A spends the stated note, with an authorized spend whose nullifier matches
fix.bob: Receives only R, which commits to A's txid. He cannot send A. His safety does not depend on A: R is time-locked whatever its input. His lock no longer requires the coin to be on chain.
fix.reservation: The source wallet records A's input note under bank/reserved-notes and never selects it for another swap.
fix.scanning: Alice's recovery workspace witnesses A's input by note commitment (watched-notes.json), without her source viewing key.
fix.bank_funding: Regtest bank funding no longer mines a transparent coin or a split transaction.

two_party_success.on_chain: F and C have no transparent input or output; A was never broadcast; no non-coinbase transparent transaction from two blocks before F to the tip.

two_party_refund.on_chain: A mined only after the ETH order expired and the refund height passed; R spends A output 0 with sequence 0xfffffffe and lock time equal to the refund height.

browser_refund_stop_recovery.on_chain: A mined only during recovery, after the refund height; R spends it.

legacy_harness_refund.early_refund_after_auxiliary: transaction did not pass consensus validation: transaction is locked until after block height 5781

auxiliary_tamper_test.command: LATCH_AUXILIARY_FIXTURE=<copy of Alice participant dir> cargo test --release -p shielded-swap-native reject_corrupt_refund_auxiliary -- --ignored

checks.bundle_tamper_test: reject_corrupt_native_recovery_bundles on a copy of Bob's directory from the two-party success run: pass
checks.relay_privacy: check_relay_privacy.py on .local/two-party-007: pass (2 identities in clear, 6 sealed)

demo_robustness: Stopping the two-party network could orphan its Anvil, apps and signer services; the next start then used the stale Anvil and a stale signer held port 18742. Apps now kill their own process group when the network disappears; a new network reaps recorded survivors and refuses a busy Anvil port. Verified across four restarts.
limits: On a refund, A shows 20,000 zatoshi leaving the shielded pool to a fresh transparent address, and R spends it.
Alice must keep the reserved change unspent until the swap settles; spending it would make her own refund invalid (not a risk to Bob).
Public profile: the refund-time A re-proof and send (public_auxiliary_execute.py) need real funds and are not yet exercised.
public_testnet: No public transaction, deployment or faucet request.

public_profile.design: New source reservations (latch-source-inputs-v2) hold only the shielded note and keep 35,000 zatoshi of change. The unsigned graph builds A from F's change, paying the source wallet's pinned auxiliary script, and keeps it outside the reviewed files (graph.json records refund_auxiliary=deferred). The source signer verifies A spends exactly F's change and signs A before F. Preflights for funding, lock and reveal no longer query the transparent address. public_auxiliary_execute.py re-proves A from the source wallet's own checkpoints and sends it only when Alice's claim history is unexposed and the ETH order is stably empty or refunded; R then requires A's coin with the agreed confirmations.

deferred.covers: synthetic graph with A, both owner reviews, presign, recovery bundle with R spending A, both consents, source signing with SIGKILL between release marker and F, exact replay; A signed exactly once with F and never by inspection or a refused context

public_profile.funding_change: The public run needs one shielded note of at least 0.0016 TAZ and no transparent coin.
public_profile.rpc_finding: dRPC's free plan no longer serves Sepolia ('chain is not available on free plan'), and publicnode prunes the genesis block the clients verify. https://sepolia.gateway.tenderly.co passed the read-only probe (chain 11155111, genesis verified); it is now the default.
public_profile.funding_observed_read_only: Source wallet decrypted one 0.125 TAZ Ironwood note (13 confirmations at height 4513088). Alice holds 0.05 Sepolia ETH; Bob and the deployer were still unfunded.
